payload.core_mechanism_summary: Nested loops iterate over every cell, count adjacent 'o' characters, check if count is even. If any odd found, print 'NO' and halt; else 'YES'.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks each cell's neighbor condition, which is a brute-force complete search. It does not use backtracking, bitmask, branch-and-bound, DFS/BFS, or permutation enumeration. Given candidates, backtracking is the most generic complete_search subtype, though not a perfect match.
